summary: Westravelle Analytical service catalogue (WA-CAT-2025 Rev 01, QA-approved June 2025, group template): ICH chamber programme with storage conditions, stability pulls and testing, method validation to ICH Q2(R2) and early-phase qualification, method transfer prerequisites, sample planning examples, submission requirements, reporting boundaries and how to enquire.
header: WESTRAVELLE ANALYTICAL | SERVICE CATALOGUE 2025 | WA-CAT-2025 Rev 01

title_block.title: ANALYTICAL AND STABILITY SERVICES
title_block.subtitle: Service catalogue 2025
lines: Westravelle Analytical Ltd, a Tarnovell company, York
Document WA-CAT-2025 Rev 01 | QA approved 12/06/2025 | Owner: Head of Analytical Services

blocks.p: 1.1 Westravelle provides analytical chemistry and stability testing for small-molecule drug substances and drug products, from early development to registration batches. 1.2 Every study runs under a numbered protocol, with batch identity, packaging and storage recorded at each step. 1.3 Our reports state results within the tested interval; shelf-life and specification decisions remain with the client.

2.1 Chambers are temperature- and humidity-mapped annually and monitored continuously with independent alarms. 2.2 Excursions are investigated and reported to the client as deviation notes with an impact assessment.

list: 3.1 Pulls within ±7 days of the nominal date up to 12 months and ±14 days thereafter
3.2 Tests by protocol: appearance, assay, related substances, water (KF), dissolution, microbial limits by arrangement
3.3 Data summary issued within 15 working days of each pull; out-of-specification results phoned through within one working day

rows: Specificity, linearity and range (80-120%), accuracy, repeatability, intermediate precision
Specificity incl. forced degradation, linearity from LOQ, accuracy at LOQ and specification, precision, LOQ, robustness
Reduced set agreed per protocol: specificity, linearity, repeatability, LOQ for specified impurities
table.caption: Table 2 Validation scope

list: 5.1 Prerequisites: validated or qualified method, method history, reference standards with certificates, representative batch
5.2 Comparative testing on one or two batches with pre-agreed acceptance criteria
5.3 Transfer report signed by both laboratories before stability use

blocks.p: 6.1 Quantities are calculated per protocol from the tests at each pull, plus 10% contingency. Example for a capsule product on three conditions for 12 months:

list: 7.1 Stability lots in final packaging with batch certificate and packaging description
7.2 Reference standards and impurity markers with certificates of analysis
7.3 Completed sample submission form (WA-F-021) and shipping conditions
7.4 Hazard information and any controlled-substance licences

blocks.p: 8.1 Interim reports at agreed time points; final reports with trend tables and plots against specification. 8.2 Conclusions stay within the tested interval; extrapolation and shelf-life proposals are the client's decision.

9.1 Formulation support is available from Durnesswick Laboratories and DMPK from Merrivoss Bioanalysis, both Tarnovell companies; ask your Westravelle contact for a joint proposal. 9.2 Enquiries: Dr A. Penrose, Head of Analytical Services, Westravelle Analytical Ltd, York.
